task: Confirm resourcing & submit requests for UAT support (2-weeks prior to UAT)
description: This task is for the PM to work with the customer to confirm UAT timing & details (e.g., on-site vs remote, testing plan/schedule, etc.) and align CI resources appropriately to support the event. Once the details are finalized, the PM will submit the necessary resource requests to ensure the event is supported appropriately.

Application Demonstrations are designed for the Delivery Consultant and Solution Architect to conduct hands on demonstrations walking client Super Users through the completed applications/integrations, end-to-end. Ideally, we group the demonstrations by process group/application set (Inbound, Inventory, Outbound). Best practice is to perform the walk through on customer devices. Leverage the approved test scripts as part of our walkthrough. Cloud Inventory to perform any issue remediation or address training items as needed. Any issues will be documented as an issue and tracked in Jira, associated with the application/integration where the problem occurred (use the 'Bug' issue type, but please note this does not indicate a product bug). These demonstrations are to occur iteratively throughout the development cycle as components of the process groups/applications sets are completed. 
Allows client Super Users & impacted customer stakeholders first hand exposure to the solutions and allows for feedback prior to customer testing/UAT. The goal is to get feedback as early as possible to allow enough time to make adjustments as needed. Note: any new requirements or out of scope changes need to be raised to customer PM and sponsor for CO approval before any action is taken to address them.

Review any/all remediation work that has occurred following the demonstrations to ensure solution set is ready for the Conference Room Pilot. Addressed items must be reviewed internally and if time allows, should be re-presented to the customer prior to the Conference Room Pilot.
Ensure that all takeaways from the initial solution workshops have been addressed in order to have a successful work.
task_formula: IF(Calculations!E55=0,"Not Included - Application Remediation Review", "Application Remediation Review")

task: Not Included - Solution Workshop / Conference Room Pilot and Train the Trainer
description:
The Solution Workshop / Conference Room Pilot is typically an on-site event where the SA, DC, and PM assist the customer to run through the Cloud Inventory solution we have created end-to-end, leveraging the customer-built test scripts. The customer super users will be executing the transactions on their devices/scanners that will be used in production. 
This exercise should be used for the Cloud Inventory team to train the super users on how to use the system, how to troubleshoot issues, and enable them to train the remaining UAT users and be the initial triage layer before reporrting issues back to Cloud Inventory. This is the intial transfer of ownership of the solution from Cloud Inventory to the customer.
